overview: The governing circle of the restored Jedi Order, guiding training and galactic stewardship after the fall of the Sith.
history: Jedi High Council governed galactic affairs during the New Jedi Order. Detailed chronicles, succession rules, and institutional structure will be expanded in a future update.
significance: Jedi High Council shaped the political identity of its era and remains a reference point when historians compare later governments across the Star Wars timeline.
notableEvents: Jedi High Council established as a governing authority in galactic records
